message.spacing: Do not override Button spacing. Use standard Button sizes (sm, default, lg, icon).
message.default: Do not restyle Button. Use standard variants (default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive) or compose with a wrapper component. Never invent domain-specific variants like chat-variant.
Use standard Badge variants (default, secondary, outline, destructive). Do not hardcode custom styles or invent one-off variants.

shadcn/no-raw-colors.message: Do not use raw Tailwind colors (e.g. bg-blue-500, text-emerald-400). Use MGC AI semantic tokens from ui/DESIGN.md (bg-background, bg-card, bg-primary, text-muted-foreground).

shadcn/no-arbitrary-values.message: Do not use arbitrary bracket values (e.g. p-[13px], w-[320px]). Use the design system scale.
